news.title: ciflow/trunk/203556: [FSDP2] Reuse reduce input for singleton groups
news.dek: For a shard group of size one, foreach_reduce allocated a separate reduce-scatter output and copied the packed input into it even though no collective runs. Large unreplicated expert groups can make that redundant output GiB-scale, and CUDA graph capture retains it in the graph-p
news.aiSummary: In FSDP2, the foreach_reduce function previously allocated a separate output buffer and copied data for shard groups of size one, even though no collective communication was required. This change reuses the input buffer to avoid redundant memory allocation, which is significant for large unreplicated expert groups where the extra output could reach gigabytes in size and persist during CUDA graph capture.
